verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports open-format export of scan results (SARIF) and a platform API to gather findings/projects, plus local CLI scanning that never uploads code by default (dry-run, no login required), which supports data portability and avoiding lock-in. However there's no documented comprehensive 'export all your data' feature covering full platform history, configs, and org data in one open bundle. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/account-level data export documentation, confirmation of open formats beyond SARIF (e.g., JSON schema docs), and independent verification of a full data portability workflow.
